name:  simple python for the cache 
on: [push]
jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: yaha pe hum checkout krke repo se data nikal lenge
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: yaha hum python use karenge jis se mere modules or code ke liye run kr sake
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: Install depedencies
        run: | 
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
      - name:  Run pytest
        run: pytest
